card.name: Word right after "from"
card.fires_on: The word or space right after "from", such as "from other", "from a", "from the" or a number. It also fires on a few linking words after "from" in a longer phrase.

modes.label: Article or determiner after from
modes.description: A small word like a, the or other directly follows "from".
modes.example: from<< a>> patient receiving INVOKAMET or INV

modes.label: Space before a number after from
modes.description: The gap before a number that follows "from" in a range or count.
modes.example: from<< >>2 to 4 weeks of continued therapy

modes.label: Linking word in a from phrase
modes.description: A word such as and, by or off in a phrase that began with "from".
modes.example: from in vitro<< and>> animal studies suggest that carbapenems
